description: An explore-context profile is always an agent call with no diff, whatever the manifest mode.

expected.prompt:
依赖锐评: review the project dependencies for risk — this is NOT a diff review.

Explore the repository yourself; there is no diff payload. Be BLUNT. Praise nothing that does not deserve it.

Judge what you review against these engineering principles, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO them (a defect no principle names is still a finding), and against the repository's own principles where you can see them (its CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md and .claude/rules/):
- first-principles (First principles): Decisions derive from the actual system and current requirements, not from templates, habits or precedent; assumptions that shape the outcome are stated.
- no-historical-baggage (Discard historical baggage): Obsolete structures, dead paths and leftover layers are removed once no current need is served by them.
- occams-razor (Occam's razor): The simplest design that fully meets the requirement; no abstraction, option or indirection for a hypothetical need.
- single-source-of-truth (Single source of truth): Each fact or configuration lives in one authoritative place; every other representation is derived from it, never maintained beside it.
- layered-decoupling (Layered decoupling): Modules depend in one direction through narrow interfaces; no layer reaches into another's internals or upward.
- names-match-behaviour (Names match what they do): A name (function, file, flag, field) says what the thing does now; a name that misleads is a defect.
- no-backward-compatibility (No backward compatibility): No shims, aliases or dual paths kept for old callers or formats; callers move with the change.
- progressive-disclosure (Progressive disclosure): An entry point states only what is needed first and points to the detail; detail is not front-loaded or duplicated across levels.
Tag each finding with the ids of the principles it violates in `principles`; leave it out when none applies.

Scope: Known CVEs / security advisories in pinned versions; Outdated major versions and unmaintained packages; License issues / incompatibilities; Unused or duplicate dependencies

Respond with ONLY a JSON object { "findings": [...] }; an empty array means you found nothing. Each finding is one object conforming to this JSON Schema:
{"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","title":"sharp-review reviewer finding","type":"object","required":["severity","summary","category"],"properties":{"severity":{"type":"string","enum":["HIGH","MEDIUM","LOW","INFO"]},"file":{"type":"string"},"summary":{"type":"string"},"category":{"type":"string","enum":["Bug","Feature","Performance"]},"suggestion":{"type":"string"},"detail":{"type":"string"},"principles":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","enum":["first-principles","no-historical-baggage","occams-razor","single-source-of-truth","layered-decoupling","names-match-behaviour","no-backward-compatibility","progressive-disclosure"]},"description":"Ids of the principles this finding violates; an unknown id refuses the finding."}}}
